For the liability clause, please ensure the cap on consequential damages aligns with our insurance coverage limits—last quarter we bumped the policy to $5M so the contract language should reflect that. The estimates show we could reduce quarterly overruns by roughly 18-22%, but I want to confirm these numbers align with what operations and legal are seeing from vendor contract discussions. Agent 0, does your liability clause review affect any existing vendor spending commitments we should account for before I finalize the protocols?

Also, I noticed the parking validation machine near reception is out of service—I'll check with building management today.
